edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key in transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowed mapping owner key in approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require check.
msg.sender is forwarded as an argument into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenOwner is used to read balances[tokenOwner] in balanceOf.
to is used to credit balances[to] in transfer.
tokens amount is applied to balances in transfer.
spender is the inner key written in allowed.
tokens is the allowance value written to allowed.
from is debited in balances during transferFrom.
from is the outer key of allowed debited in transferFrom.
to is credited in balances during transferFrom.
tokens amount is applied to balances in transferFrom.
tokens amount is subtracted from allowed in transferFrom.
spender is the inner key written in allowed by approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance value written to allowed by approveAndCall.
spender is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
attacker-supplied data bytes are forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens is forwarded into the external ERC20 transfer call.
_newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
safeAdd performs addition and the overflow require check.
safeSub performs subtraction and the underflow require check.
safeMul performs multiplication and the overflow require check.
approveAndCall invokes the external contract receiveApproval after updating allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the external token transfer function.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner require on msg.sender.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
MDIVToken constructor sets _totalSupply and pre-mints to a fixed address.
MDIVToken constructor initializes symbol.
MDIVToken constructor initializes name.
MDIVToken constructor initializes decimals.
The spender contract callback can re-enter transferFrom while approveAndCall is executing.
The spender contract callback can re-enter transfer while approveAndCall is executing.
External receiveApproval callback can manipulate the balances state via reentrant token calls.
External receiveApproval callback can manipulate the allowed state via reentrant approve calls.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only meaningful as the input to balanceOf balance lookup.
to exists only as the destination argument of transfer.
tokens exists only as the amount argument of transfer.
spender exists only as the allowance key argument of approve.
tokens exists only as the allowance amount argument of approve.
from exists only as the source argument of transferFrom.
to exists only as the destination argument of transferFrom.
tokens exists only as the amount argument of transferFrom.
spender is used as the external call target and allowance key, so it collapses into the unsafe external call.
tokens is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
data is opaque payload forwarded directly to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary external contract target of the rescue transfer.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
_newOwner exists only to be written into newOwner by transferOwnership.
